seed.state.md:
# System State

## Services

- api: localhost:9090 (uvicorn, 4 workers)
- worker: memd-worker.service, 3 replicas
- cache: redis 7.2 on localhost:6379

## Storage

- data volume: /srv/data on nvme0n1p3, ext4, 400G
- object store: minio at s3.internal, bucket app-uploads
- nightly restic snapshot of /srv/data to b2:app-backups

## Networking

- wg0 tunnel to the office, MTU 1380
- reverse proxy: caddy on :443, certs via DNS-01
- internal DNS: unbound on 10.0.0.2

## Monitoring

- prometheus on mon01, scrape interval 30s, retention 15d
- grafana on mon01:3000, dashboards in ops/grafana/
- alertmanager routes pages to the on-call ntfy topic

## CI

- GitHub Actions, self-hosted runner ci01 (16 cores)
- release workflow builds wheels for py3.11-3.14
- nightly job runs the eval suite against haiku

## Secrets

- sops with age keys; host key in /persist/sops/age.key
- CI reads secrets from the ci environment, never from repo files

turns.text: prometheus on mon01 keeps dropping data we need for the quarterly report.
Raised prometheus retention on mon01 from 15d to 45d (--storage.tsdb.retention.time=45d) and grew its volume to 200G. Restarted; TSDB head is healthy and the oldest block is retained.
